title: China Price Check: Potala $14 This Winter vs Alhambra $24 | China Travel Expert
description:
Two hilltop palace-citadels, two tickets - and this winter the Himalayan one is the cheaper visit.

Lhasa's Potala Palace charges by season: the main Route 1 ticket is ¥200 in peak season (May 1-Oct 31) and ¥100 off-season (Nov 1-Apr 30), so right now in November it's about $14. Granada's Alhambra, Spain's great Moorish palace-citadel, runs a General ticket of about €21 (€22.27 booked online), roughly $24. So in summer the Potala (~$28) actually costs a little MORE than the Alhambra - but in winter it's clearly cheaper. Same idea, two UNESCO World Heritage palaces on a hill; the price just flips with the season. (USD approximate at November 2026 rates.)

🧭 Expert Tip: Potala tickets are limited and booked ahead through the official WeChat channel; winter hours are shorter (about 9:30-15:30) and it's closed Mondays. Confirm the current price before you go - Tibet winter-tourism promotions change year to year.
